Judah Lewis is a young actor born on May 22, 2001 in the United States. He began his acting career at a young age, making his film debut in the 2014 movie "Deliverance Creek." Lewis gained recognition for his role in the 2016 horror-comedy film "The Babysitter," where he played the lead role of Cole Johnson.

Since then, Judah Lewis has appeared in several films and television shows, including "Demolition," "The Christmas Chronicles," and "Summer of 84." He has garnered praise for his performances in these projects, showcasing his talent as a versatile and talented young actor.

Judah Lewis continues to gain popularity in the industry, and his career is on the rise. He is known for his charismatic on-screen presence and ability to bring depth and emotion to his roles. Lewis is considered a promising young talent in Hollywood, and many fans and critics are excited to see what he will do next in his career.
